'''Alva''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] hailing from the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. Alva was married to [[Evun]] and had two children. Together with her teenage brother [[Theel (nomad)|Theel]], Alva and the four were nomads who lived in the [[Scraplands/Legends|Scraplands]] salvaging waste for profit. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Alva and her family were ambushed by [[Mantellian Savrip/Legends|Savrips]] on their journey to [[Fifth Wheel]]. Wearing survival gear and a homemade [[Slugthrower rifle/Legends|slugthrower rifle]], Alva and Evun attempted to hold off the Savrips while Theel guarded the children.<ref name="MPQ" />
